title: Equality of Capacity–Volume and ADM Mass
exact_target: Determine whether the mass defined from large-region capacity and volume always equals ADM mass.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004811 (OWR-8415343-014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The source reports equality for harmonically flat ends under additional hypotheses, and asks about general asymptotically flat manifolds. An exact proof must use the report's definition of the exhaustion supremum, rather than a single chosen family of regions.
